name: frontmatter-has-type
assertion: Every memory node .md file has a 'type' field in YAML frontmatter

name: slug-matches-filename
assertion: The 'slug' field matches the filename (without .md extension)

name: category-matches-directory
assertion: The 'category' field matches the parent directory name

name: required-spo-fields
assertion: Nodes with modality must/must_not have subject, predicate, and object fields for O(1) conflict detection

name: no-skill-fields-in-memory
assertion: Memory nodes do NOT contain skill-only fields (name, description). Skills do NOT contain memory fields (slug, category, importance).
